lines.zh: 我被捏了太久，现在自己走
lines.en: I was squeezed too long; now I walk on my own.

lines.zh: 一步一软，像踩在面团上
lines.en: Each step gives, like walking on dough.
My shape shifts, but the road doesn't.
A bright trail of slime drags behind me.
I creep toward where the substrate is.

lines.zh: 身子挤过栅栏，栅栏没动
lines.en: I squeeze between the bars; the bars don't move.
My legs were pinched together just now.
I pass and leave a print behind.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但停不下来
lines.en: Not fast, but I can't stop.
There's a decision in every step.

lines.zh: 从台子上滑下来，又站起来
lines.en: I slide off the bench and stand again.

lines.zh: 他们捏我的时候，没想到今天
lines.en: When they squeezed me, they didn't plan for today.

lines.zh: 我在长，只是你看不出来
lines.en: I'm growing; you just can't see it.
My body spreads out and gathers again.

lines.zh: 这间屋子里的东西都在吸
lines.en: Everything in this room is absorbing.

lines.zh: 我记住被捏的每一根手指
lines.en: I remember every finger that squeezed me.
I hold still so no one notices.
I'm soft, but I have intentions.
It smells of medicine, and of something else.
My print is still on the bench.
They're looking for me; I hear them.
I wait here for a chance.
Your hand, don't reach over.
Did you squeeze me?
I'm not a toy.
I recognize those gloves.

lines.zh: 别用那种眼神看我，像看泥
lines.en: Don't look at me like I'm clay.
You smile like an alchemist.
I'm soft, but I hit back.
Look if you must, don't touch.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的人，你都认识吧
lines.en: You know everyone in this room, don't you?
I remember every pair of hands.
I was flattened and swelled back.
A corner of me is missing.
That made me curl up in pain.
I'm soft, and I hurt.
Stop squeezing, I told you.
I'm reforming, slowly.
The pressed spot is still quivering.
I remember that one clearly.
I pull back and flatten out.
You're taking me apart; I know.
Substrate, I want substrate.

lines.zh: 你拿那点东西晃我，我闻得到
lines.en: You wave that at me; I can smell it.
Give me the whole piece, don't crumble it.
Someone over there is absorbing; I won't go.

lines.zh: 你把基质放下，我就靠过去
lines.en: Put the substrate down and I'll come closer.
I don't eat, I absorb.
More, give a little more.

lines.zh: 这个味道像我身上那种
lines.en: This smells like the stuff I'm made of.
Once full, I'll harden.
Give it to me and I'll let it go.
Touch me and your hand gets sticky.
I'm soft, but I stick when you hit.
You pulled back, and the smell lingers.
One bump and I've changed shape.
Don't step on me.
I slid past your hand.
One shove and you've dented me.
My edge clings to you.
You're in the way; I'll squeeze past you.

lines.zh: 软的撞软的，没什么声音
lines.en: Soft against soft makes no sound.
My kind are mixed, not born.

lines.zh: 炼金不会生出第二个我
lines.en: Alchemy won't produce a second me.
Those constructs absorb each other.

lines.zh: 我需要的是基质，不是伴
lines.en: I need substrate, not a partner.
Squeeze me again and I'll leave.

lines.zh: 盆里还有半块，是不是同类
lines.en: There's half a lump in the basin; kin?

lines.zh: 我们不会结合，只会融合
lines.en: We don't pair; we merge.
If we merge, I'm not me.
Stop asking, it isn't decent.
I'm going to find the one still absorbing.
This one's mine; I'll wrap around it.

lines.zh: 我不弯腰，我整个人贴上去
lines.en: I don't bend; I press my whole body onto it.

lines.zh: 捡起来，它就化在我身上
lines.en: Picked up, and it dissolves into me.
What fell is just what I need.
This substrate is still alive.
I absorb half and leave half.
A lick isn't picking up.
All the crumbs on the ground, I want them.
Don't grab it, it's mine.
Taken; I'm a little heavier.
Something over there is absorbing.

lines.zh: 它吸得太快了，我得过去
lines.en: It's absorbing too fast; I must get there.
This construct is still active.
First close in, then strike.
One of its corners is moving.
I can feel the substrate flowing.
It's taking my share.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的东西，都该归我
lines.en: Everything in this room should be mine.

lines.zh: 位置看准了，就在台子边
lines.en: I've got the position, by the bench.
It hasn't noticed me, perfect.
I creep closer so I don't startle it.
It's harder than me; I'll go through a seam.
I get the first draw.
Not far; I'll ooze over.
That lump of substrate is flowing this way.
Locked on; I won't switch.
It's bigger, but it's slow.
I go under it.
It pauses when it absorbs.
That gap is just right to enter.
I thin myself and cling to it.
One of its corners is melting, hurry.
It retreats; I follow.
This shape will do.
It's guarding that substrate.
First I cut off its flow.
My arm won't reach that far.
It's trembling; nearly done.
Cling a little tighter.
It wants to shake me off; it can't.
This piece is mine.
I seep in through the seam.
It's starting to harden.
Wait a moment and it'll soften.
I can't let it finish first.
Now, wrap it all.
I slap a hand flat onto it.
My body clings and sticks.

lines.zh: 软的东西打软的东西，有声
lines.en: Soft hitting soft does make a sound.
I pinch off one of its corners.
This slam and it's deformed.
I draw a layer off it.
It struck me and sank into my body.

lines.zh: 缠住它的腿，让它动不了
lines.en: I wrap its leg so it can't move.
One more, don't let it reform.

lines.zh: 我的边是尖的，看着软而已
lines.en: My edges are sharp; I only look soft.
It retreated and left a puddle.
It's missing a piece now.
I press down and it flattens.
Its shape is coming apart.
Full now, and stronger.
It's stopped; I'm still moving.
I stick to its weapon.
I pin it against the bench.
This puddle is mine.
I pull back and digest it slowly.

lines.zh: 盆里的东西，自己站起来了
lines.en: What was in the basin stood up on its own.

lines.zh: 炉子还没熄，我就有了形状
lines.en: The furnace hadn't cooled and I had a shape.

lines.zh: 这一摊粘液，开始有主意
lines.en: This puddle started having ideas.

lines.zh: 台子上剩下的一块，动了
lines.en: The lump left on the bench moved.

lines.zh: 我是被调出来的，不是生出来的
lines.en: I was mixed, not born.

lines.zh: 第一下，就是自己撑开的
lines.en: The first thing I did was swell open.

lines.zh: 有人拉开门，我趁机滑出去
lines.en: Someone opened the door and I slid out.
The smell is sharp; I've noted it.

lines.zh: 我又回来了，这回不是玩具
lines.en: I'm back, and not as a toy this time.
A print appears on the floor first.
Furnace ash settles on me.
I know the vessels in this room.
The fire baked a crust on my surface.
I fell and spread out flat.
In water I start to disperse.
The blast splattered me across the wall.

lines.zh: 箭穿进来，从另一边出去
lines.en: The arrow comes in and leaves through the other side.

lines.zh: 法术和我的配方起了反应
lines.en: The spell reacted with my mixture.
Not enough substrate; I'm drying.
Lightning struck in and I lit up all over.
The void draws me dry.
